scope: User, 11 Nov 2026: "this is not the exact UI I was planning on in the claude design", then "yes, build all eight". The web test client is rebuilt to the eight approved boards (canvas https://claude.ai/artifact/F7pc3VsqUyEAuj6VKip5Kb, row 'Map as the interface, printed-map look'). The user's go-ahead revises client PRD C01, C03 and C04 to the boards.

boards.1 Home: src/screens/home/: one 'לאן נוסעים?' field; Home/Work cards with the next ride; the selected stop's departures; map: stops as round pins, next-departure tags, 400 m dashed ring and puck when there is a fix
boards.2 Choose: src/screens/compare/CompareScreen.tsx + OptionRow: options as rows (times, countdown tag, legs, duration); map draws every option, others faded with an arrival-time tag that chooses it; 'פרטי המסלול'
boards.3 Step: src/screens/compare/RouteScreen.tsx + Timeline at #/route: step timeline; tapping a leg zooms the map (fitTo); 'כל המסלול'; boarding pin 'בצד הזה · לכיוון …' from API boarding.stopSide; star (saves the destination) and 'יוצאים לדרך'
boards.4 Walking: src/screens/navigate/: one answer ('הולכים אל', distance, 'מספיקים · לפי הלוח'); map follows; stop pin with line and countdown; close and 'מגיעים' floating; 'לא הגיע?' and 'עליתי'
boards.5 On board: remaining stops as vertical rows, 'יורדים בעוד N תחנות', 'אחר כך' row, 'ירדתי'; travelled part grey, framed to what is left, 'יורדים כאן'
boards.6 Bus didn't come: MissedPanel: wait here (next departure of the same route) and walk elsewhere (replan excluding the missed trip), each with its arrival; a failed check is said as such
boards.7 Tap a stop: src/screens/stop/ at #/stop/<id>: every line through the stop fans out; a chosen line shows its whole route, stops, direction and end
boards.8 Wide screen: from 900 px the sheet is a 400 px panel at the inline start beside the map (side inset for framing); Choose opens the chosen option's steps in place with Step's actions

method: Coordinator built the shared foundation (map tags and stop pins over the map, faded/travelled tones, walking ring, fitTo, cameraKey, topControls; boards.css; wide layout) and merged three Opus agents' worktree branches (Home+Stop, Choose+Step, Walking/On board/Missed). API data from PR #35 (branch served live on 127.0.0.1:8520) is read as optional fields with fallbacks for an API without them.

checks.e2eMocked: Windows, Playwright 1.64.1 Chromium, 2 workers, VITE_MAP_STYLE empty (the git-ignored apps/web/.env.fixtures.local turns real tiles on for the local demo and must not apply to e2e): 87 passed, 0 failed, 6 skipped (@real). Includes axe in both themes and the new wide-screen spec. Earlier 4-worker runs on this loaded PC showed single timing failures that passed alone.
checks.liveWalkthrough: Browser pane at 375x812 (and 1200x760 for board 8), dark theme, client on Vite dev against the PR #35 API on :8520 (generation nov11a): Home near Dizengoff Center → Search 'רכבת הרצליה' → Choose (3 options) → Step → navigation (at the stop) → 'לא הגיע?' → 'הגיע, עליתי' → On board; then #/stop/mot:stop:13561 with line 8 chosen; then Choose at 1200x760.
notRun: light theme screenshots (axe runs in both themes in the mocked e2e)

foundFixedDuringReview: Bus didn't come said 'no other option' when the next-bus check had failed (504); it now says which check failed and offers a retry
Tags near the map's side were clipped (Step's boarding tag); they now open inward
Fitting failed with NaN bounds on 360x640 under a tall sheet once top padding cleared the floating controls; padding now gives way
Home re-framed the map every minute as its tags ticked, undoing panning; scenes can now frame once per cameraKey
'יורדים כאן' landed under the close button; fitting now keeps clear of the top band and floating controls
Lint: MapView read a ref during render for the overlay; the loaded map is held in state
deliberateDifferences: 'כל המסלול' and Navigate's close button sit below the shell's top band (Back and the attribution live in it)
'מתוכנן' is said once on Choose: every time is scheduled until realtime ships
The star saves the destination as a favourite (labelled so); the client has no saved trips
Home shows at most two map tags (stops are 30-150 m apart; a tag on every pin buries them); every pin's spoken name carries its next departure
A tapped stop's line direction is a small arrow tag, not a chevron drawn on the line
Waiting at a stop (a trip that starts with a ride) shows 'מחכים בתחנה' with a countdown; 'עליתי' boards on the same step
Long rides name only the next stop and the one before the exit; the rest are one 'N תחנות' row
The Home card for an active trip ('חזרה לניווט') is kept above the search field
knownGaps: Platforms: the MOT feed has none, so 'רציף N' never shows
PR #35 (API) is not merged; on an API without it the screens fall back (more requests, no side of the road, client-side route filter)
Under load the local API answers 504 when its engine is slow (about 1.5 s); screens say so and offer retry
Home's stop names stay Hebrew in English (the nearby endpoint returns no translations)
Not published to H-1 (needs the opentransit AWS profile)
